intent_summary: Explicitly incomplete trailing observations are reported as data quality evidence and excluded from completed-series analysis.

criteria.criterion: Incomplete observations form a trailing suffix after chronological preparation.
criteria.notes: Suffix validation runs after timestamp preparation and rejects a completed observation following an incomplete one.

criteria.criterion: The observed values and timestamps of unfinished periods remain available in data quality output.
criteria.notes: Quality records retain original source index, normalized timestamp, observed value, and incomplete status.

criteria.criterion: Incomplete source samples are excluded from expectations, calibration, point scoring, and completed aggregates.
criteria.notes: Only finalized prepared values enter either scoring path; assertions verify the last scored sample and both multi-resolution counts.

criteria.criterion: A relationship with an unavailable latest source reports that unavailability rather than normal behavior.
criteria.notes: Incomplete aligned sources become unavailable values, and latest relationship state/status plus MCP headline explain the lack of evidence.
